context: The M8-B benchmark result (R2_M8_B_CANVAS_BENCHMARK_RESULT.json, branch impl/r2-m8b-creative-canvas) reports status_strict FAIL and status_clarified PASS. The thresholds are unchanged; the sponsor accepts two measurement clarifications of how they are read.

clarifications.reading: A frame-time p95 may exceed its threshold by one clock quantum (0.1 ms).
clarifications.evidence: An untouched, empty Canvas measured the same way has idle p95, p99 and max of 16.8 ms, with about 39-40% of samples above 16.7 ms (60 Hz plus Chromium's coarsened timer). Several strict entries read 16.700000000000273 ms, a floating-point artifact of rAF deltas.

clarifications.reading: The initial app bundle must hold no Creative Canvas or React Flow module (checked on a sourcemapped build). The byte delta of the lazy route registration, which any lazy route adds, is reported but does not fail the gate.
clarifications.evidence: Measured initial delta 0.41-0.42 KB gzip, JS only (route registration and the lazy import's preload list); initial_canvas_modules is empty; the lazy Canvas chunk is 72.9 KB gzip against a 250 KB limit.

unchanged: Every other threshold and the pass rule apply as frozen. The clarified verdict is the acceptance verdict; the strict verdict stays recorded.
